steps.instruction: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter with 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a large sauté pan.
steps.spoken: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter with 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 large diced onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add 1 tablespoon of minced garlic and sauté until golden.
Take the onion mixture out of the pan and set it aside to cool.
Mix 2 cups of shredded cooked chicken with the onion mixture.
Mix in 1/4 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and 1 cup of cheese.
Lay enough cornbread in a lined roasting pan to lightly coat the bottom.
steps.spoken: Use 3 cups of finely crumbled cornbread in all. Lay enough cornbread in the bottom of a parchment-lined, high-sided roasting pan to lightly coat the bottom.

steps.instruction: Put a layer of the chicken mixture on top.
Repeat the layers until all the cornbread and chicken mixture are used.
Mix 1 cup of cheese, 2/3 cup of breadcrumbs and 1/4 cup of melted butter.
Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture over the top layer.
Cover with foil and bake in the center of the oven for 20 minutes.
Take off the foil and bake for 15 more minutes.
steps.spoken: Take off the foil and bake for 15 more minutes, until the top is browned and bubbly.
